items.source: Returns the value of the executable record component.
items.translation: 返回 `executable` 记录组件的值。

items.source: Returns the value of the targetClass record component.
items.translation: 返回 `targetClass` 记录组件的值。

items.source: Descriptor for how a bean should be instantiated. While the targetClass is usually the declaring class of the executable (in case of a constructor or a locally declared factory method), there are cases where retaining the actual concrete class is necessary (for example, for an inherited factory method).
items.translation: 描述如何实例化 Bean 的说明。虽然 `targetClass` 通常是 `executable` 的声明类（在构造函数或本地声明的工厂方法的情况下），但在某些情况下，保留实际的实现类是必要的（例如，对于继承的工厂方法）。

items.translation: 创建 `<code>InstantiationDescriptor` 记录类的实例。

items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
items.translation: 指示其他对象是否“等于”此对象。如果另一个对象属于同一类且所有记录组件都相等，则这两个对象相等。此记录类中的所有组件均使用 Objects::equals(Object,Object) 进行比较。

items.translation: 返回此记录类的字符串表示形式。

items.source: Returns a string representation of this record class. The representation contains the name of the class, followed by the name and value of each of the record components.
items.translation: 返回此记录类的字符串表示形式。该表示形式包含类名，后跟每个记录组件的名称和值。

items.source: Returns a hash code value for this object. The value is derived from the hash code of each of the record components.
items.translation: 返回此对象的哈希码值。该值由每个记录组件的哈希码推导得出。
